items.label: identity
items.normalized_content: Dostoevskian Cybernetics: causal error attribution for efficient structural adaptation under environmental shift.

items.label: central_hypothesis
items.normalized_content: Prediction error or contradiction detection does not identify the responsible internal cause; explicit causal attribution before revision is hypothesized to improve adaptation efficiency.

items.label: minimum_revision_objective
items.normalized_content: Optimize correction generation toward minimum sufficient structural change while preserving the ability to refuse unjustified revision.

items.label: research_philosophy
items.normalized_content: Contradiction is treated as evidence about the process that generated a conclusion, motivating localization across observation, inference or assumption, mechanism, representation, and interface.

items.label: recursive_error_metabolism
items.normalized_content: Ask what failed, why, what smallest revision is required, and whether the cause is identifiable.

items.label: cf ae_role
items.normalized_content: CFAE inserts a diagnostic attribution layer between contradiction detection and model modification.

items.label: factored_shock_benchmark
items.normalized_content: Factored Shock Benchmark is proposed to test attribution across controlled shift, noise, compound, deceptive, and non-identifiable conditions.

items.label: evaluation_scope
items.normalized_content: Evaluation extends performance recovery with attribution validity, structural-change cost, and knowledge preservation.

items.label: failure_level_1
items.normalized_content: Level 1 observation failure addresses corrupted or noisy observation and favors filtering or observation-side repair without broad structural revision.

items.label: failure_level_2
items.normalized_content: Level 2 inference failure treats isolated or stochastic contradiction as insufficient for structural revision and accumulates evidence.

items.label: failure_level_3
items.normalized_content: Level 3 mechanism failure localizes changed causal relationships and revises only the failing mechanism.

items.label: failure_level_4
items.normalized_content: Level 4 representation failure addresses inadequate variables or abstractions and may require structural expansion without erasing prior knowledge.

items.label: failure_level_5
items.normalized_content: Level 5 interface failure addresses non-identifiability and prescribes halt, provenance preservation, competing hypotheses, and an epistemic-limit signal.

items.label: factorization_criterion
items.normalized_content: README expresses interface sufficiency as L = L_hat ∘ O.

items.label: a_epistemic
items.normalized_content: A_epistemic counts correct attribution plus correct abstention over contradictions.

items.label: c_improve_formula
items.normalized_content: C_improve = ΔP_future /(ΔI_necessary + λΔI_unnecessary) × A_epistemic.

items.label: c_improve_components
items.normalized_content: ΔP_future is future recovery; ΔI_necessary justified change; ΔI_unnecessary structural churn; λ penalizes unnecessary change.

items.label: agent_A
items.normalized_content: Agent A: monolithic no-attribution baseline.

items.label: agent_B
items.normalized_content: Agent B: factored model with global update, isolating whether modularity alone is sufficient.

items.label: agent_E
items.normalized_content: Agent E: factored model with random attribution, probing whether attribution accuracy matters.

items.label: agent_C
items.normalized_content: Agent C: factored model plus CFAE causal diagnosis; proposed mechanism condition.

items.label: agent_D
items.normalized_content: Agent D: factored model with oracle attribution; proposed upper bound.

items.label: clean_shock
items.normalized_content: Single-factor identifiable shift condition.

items.label: stochastic_noise
items.normalized_content: Transient-noise condition testing resistance to premature revision.

items.label: compound_failure
items.normalized_content: Multiple simultaneous failure condition testing escalation and multi-hypothesis reasoning.

items.label: deceptive_correlation
items.normalized_content: Spurious-correlation condition testing resistance to false causal or representation assumptions.

items.label: interface_wall
items.normalized_content: Non-identifiable condition testing epistemic halt and correct abstention.

items.label: described_repository_structure
items.normalized_content: README depicts experiments/ and results/benchmarks as repository structure; actual frozen-tree conflict is kept separately.

items.label: explicit_research_status
items.normalized_content: Repository is a proposed framework and experimental program with no claimed benchmark result; fundamental empirical and theoretical questions remain open.

items.label: interface_model
items.normalized_content: World or latent state is mediated by interface I with O_t=I(W_t); an explicit hypothesis space is maintained.

items.label: action_conditioned_identifiability
items.normalized_content: THEORY calls a failure hypothesis distinguishable when some action yields information I(H;O|a)>0.

items.label: action_conditioned_nonidentifiability
items.normalized_content: If competing hypotheses induce identical observations under all available actions, the distinction is unrecoverable under the current interface.

items.label: epistemic_halt
items.normalized_content: When action-conditioned discrimination is zero, preserve uncertainty and competing hypotheses and halt structural update rather than force a choice.

items.label: provenance_reopenability
items.normalized_content: Beliefs should preserve reasons, supporting evidence, falsifiers, discarded alternatives, and reopening paths for reversible commitment.

items.label: cf ae_algorithm
items.normalized_content: Suspend global updates; generate failure hypotheses; accumulate evidence; choose diagnostic interventions; make smallest sufficient revision; preserve provenance.

items.label: factored_model
items.normalized_content: CFAE assumes M={O_hat,T_hat,R_hat}.

items.label: residual_family
items.normalized_content: CFAE defines observation, transition, and reward residuals for the factored components.

items.label: contradiction_threshold
items.normalized_content: A contradiction is declared when max(e_O,e_T,e_R)>ε.

items.label: shock_noise_evidence
items.normalized_content: CFAE contrasts H_shock vs H_noise using a log-likelihood accumulator K and revises only when K>θ.

items.label: active_discrimination
items.normalized_content: Choose diagnostic action a*=argmax_a I(H;O|a), prioritizing information about failure source rather than immediate reward.

items.label: surgical_revision
items.normalized_content: Minimize ||ΔM|| subject to error reduction; update only the implicated O/T/R component, while representation failure may expand structure.

items.label: correct_attribution_and_abstention
items.normalized_content: A_epistemic rewards true-source attribution and justified abstention, while permanent refusal is explicitly under-update.

items.label: performance_recovery_measurement
items.normalized_content: ΔP_future is specified by an integral relative to target performance and may alternatively be operationalized via recovery-curve area, latency, or steps to baseline; sign semantics remain separately unresolved.

items.label: revision_cost_components
items.normalized_content: Necessary change is minimum justified modification; unnecessary change is churn; λ weights unnecessary revision cost.

items.label: knowledge_retention
items.normalized_content: K_retain measures preservation over unaffected components only.

items.label: attribution_efficiency
items.normalized_content: A_local = ΔI_correct/ΔI_total, intended to distinguish targeted diagnosis from lucky recovery.

items.label: benchmark_metric_mapping
items.normalized_content: Benchmark conditions are mapped to localization, evidence accumulation, multi-hypothesis escalation, causal-assumption resistance, and abstention or calibration.

items.label: composite_score_boundary
items.normalized_content: No single scalar is claimed sufficient; an optional product score may be used only while reporting C_improve, A_epistemic, K_retain, and A_local separately.

items.label: scaling_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Discrete failure-hypothesis enumeration may not scale; amortized causal inference is a proposed direction.

items.label: explicit_vs_implicit_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Whether explicit attribution beats powerful implicit adaptation remains open and requires capacity and complexity controlled comparison with strong alternatives.

items.label: level4_discovery_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Current CFAE assumes meaningful O/T/R factors; autonomous detection and restructuring of inadequate representations remains open.

items.label: dynamic_lambda_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Learning λ is open; stable-versus-volatile environment predictions are proposed but circular self-adjustment is a stated risk.

items.label: interface_expansion_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Epistemic halt prevents unjustified revision but does not create missing information; active interface expansion or tool creation remains open.

items.label: multi_agent_open_problem
items.normalized_content: How agents exchange diagnoses, hypotheses, and uncertainty without false authority remains open; provenance and confidence sharing is proposed.

items.label: boundary_conditions_open_problem
items.normalized_content: Attribution is not claimed universally beneficial; stationary, uniform-error, and high-representation-cost regimes are candidate overhead boundaries.

items.label: frozen_tree_conflict
items.normalized_content: README-described experiments and results paths are absent from the immutable frozen tree; actual persisted head is documentation-only apart from .gitignore.

items.label: unresolved_recovery_sign
items.normalized_content: Intended sign or normalization of ΔP_future is not established by the source.

items.label: unresolved_failure_depth_overlap
items.normalized_content: Observation-mapping change is compatible with both Level 1 and Level 3 classifications; discriminator is absent.

items.label: unresolved_identifiability_relation
items.normalized_content: Relation between target factorization L=L_hat∘O and action-conditioned hypothesis discrimination I(H;O|a) is not source-established.

items.label: unresolved_state_observability
items.normalized_content: CFAE transition residual directly uses s_{t+1} while theory mediates world state through observation; state-access contract is unspecified.

items.label: unresolved_zero_denominator
items.normalized_content: C_improve convention for justified zero-revision and zero-denominator cases is unspecified.
